tags.inscription:
TONY TADAO MITANI of Kumagai Gumi Japan helped build Sydney Harbour Tunnel, opened 1992.
Tony always loved the sea, land and people of big Australia.
Look out over the bay. It’s good to be alive and here. Ann-Marie really loved this place.
Take a break and collect your thoughts, just like AA.

For our mother Wong Chau Yuk Bing who loved flowers
1999
In loving memory of Robert William Turton
